Author: Jacob5800
Name: Portrait Atelier
Description: Create and apply curated portrait designs from your own character in one click.
Punchline: Make and apply a portrait in one click.
Changelog:
### 0.1.4.0
- Updated compatibility for FFXIV patch 7.57.

### 0.1.3.0
- Added one-click portrait styling with curated looks and generated variations.
- Added options to use unlocked poses and expressions and owned backgrounds, frames, and decorations, while keeping the current character or banner design when desired.
- Improved validation and application of changes in the in-game editor.

Author: Jacob5800
Name: Retainer Pricer
Punchline: Price listings and manage retainer ventures.
Description: Price eligible retainer listings with Universalis and a configurable match or one-gil-undercut rule. Manage retainer ventures using the game's own retainer UI.
Changelog:
### 0.5.0.9

- Reduced Sniper to two concurrent 100-item history batches. Smaller 50/25-item fallback retries remain available. This reduces load but does not guarantee Universalis timeouts are resolved.
- Scan progress now says items and batches attempted, with separate history-loaded and failed-item counts. The disabled retry button explains that retries become available after the scan finishes.
- Added Dalamud log diagnostics for failed history requests: scope, item IDs, batch size, history days, sales cap, attempt number, elapsed time and error. Logs also record fallback splitting and scan summaries to help diagnose persistent failures.
- The bottom-left version label and feedback reports now display all four version numbers, such as 0.5.0.9.
